name: Navion
full_name: Nanoflex magnetic telerobotic platform (Navion per S8)
n_dof_detail: tip direction by field vector + advance of two devices
imaging_compat: mobile field generator compatible with C-arm
validation_detail: 7,000 km in-vitro coronary angiography, 260 runs, latency 134-143 ms (madder2025_transatlantic via S8); CTO reports 100% navigation + clot retrieval (magneticsmag, web)
key_numbers: no first-in-human found; FIH/FDA submission once planned for Q3 2023 (slipped)
